name: Mirren: Star Legends
storyline:
Throughout the 120,000 years of Mirren's history, angels, humans, elves, demons, orcs, and dragons—all races and species—have had their moments in the spotlight. Their attempts to coexist created periods of prosperity and periods of disaster as chaos challenged order time and time again.

That was until the witch Lilia offered the final note for this chaotic overture. She selflessly absorbed all the world's darkness and welcomed chaos upon herself, marking the start of Mirren's "Era of Innocence."

After this act of sacrifice, Lilia suddenly disappeared... As the Lord Oracle, you will continue her legacy alongside the Novas and Asters. Together, we must sustain this song of innocence!
summary: Mirren: Star Legends – A Fantasy Adventure Through Time and Chaos!
